decisions.reason: As a near-core candle-arch line using existing craft capabilities, it is still a relatively low-cost option to retain, even though several seasons of market exposure and limited recent visibility raise some pruning risk.
This one-tier Christmas pyramid sits firmly in the firm's traditional business and can be carried within a broad handcrafted range at low strategic cost, so management would usually keep it.

The electronic music box is farther from the firm's craft-centered core, its related platform options were already abandoned, and after several years the uncertainty has likely resolved enough to justify ending the experiment.
Because the Dresden-themed pyramid builds on proven pyramid know-how and remains close to the established premium seasonal offer, it is still worth keeping unless sales data turn clearly negative.
